reference.pathophysiology: Reed-Sternberg cells mark contiguous Hodgkin with B symptoms; NHL bulks extranodally with Burkitt jaw and TLS risk, and elderly CLL smudges CD5-positive with autoimmune cytopenias and Richter transformation.
additionalDifferentials: Hodgkin versus NHL versus CLL versus TB by Reed bulk smudge and caseation
Indolent versus aggressive by tempo and LDH
B symptoms versus none by sweats weight and itch
additionalInvestigations: Excision biopsy with Ann Arbor PET
